reports.title: Datadog Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: •Fourth Quarter 2026 Outlook
section: ◦Non-GAAP operating income between $280 million and $290 million.
◦Non-GAAP net income per share between $0.69 and $0.71, assuming approximately 379 million weighted average diluted shares outstanding.
◦Non-GAAP operating income between $1.095 billion and $1.105 billion.
◦Non-GAAP net income per share between $2.73 and $2.75, assuming approximately 375 million weighted average diluted shares outstanding.

desk.headline: Revenue up 35% to $1.20bn, beat; 2026 outlook raised, but Q4 guide assumes largest customer cuts to its minimum

numbers.eps_basis: diluted GAAP (calendar estimate); non-GAAP diluted EPS $0.81 vs $0.55, against a $0.64 estimate

results: Revenue grew 35% to $1.20bn, above the company's own $1.135–1.145bn range and the $1.15bn estimate.
The business turned a GAAP operating profit of $75m (6% margin) from a small loss a year ago; non-GAAP operating margin rose to 28% from 23%.
GAAP diluted EPS was $0.32 against $0.10, and non-GAAP EPS $0.81 against $0.55.
Operating cash flow was $290m and free cash flow $251m; cash and securities reached $5.2bn.
Customers paying $100k+ a year rose 20% to about 4,860.

guidance.summary: Datadog lifted its 2026 revenue, operating profit and EPS ranges. The Q4 revenue range of $1.19–1.20bn (up 25–26%) is roughly flat on Q3 because it assumes the largest customer drops to its contract minimum.

points: The largest customer cut its usage in Q3 but stayed above its minimum; Q4 guidance assumes it pays only that minimum. Without it, implied Q4 growth is low-to-mid 30s%.
Growth outside AI customers sped up for a fifth straight quarter, into the high 20s%; AI customers rose to over 850.
Net revenue retention held in the low 120s% and gross retention in the mid-to-high 90s%.
Remaining contract value (RPO) rose 38% to $3.85bn; billings grew 30% to $1.16bn, partly held back by early renewals at volume discounts.
The CFO said guidance is built on recent trends with a cushion; 2027 guidance comes with Q4 results.
call.source: Call transcript via TradingKey (4 Nov 2026); Capital.com call brief, 4 Nov 2026; 24/7 Wall St, 4 Nov 2026
